products.name: Braintrust
products.note: Evaluation-first LLM platform; datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, prompt iteration with production trace feedback

profile_text.body:
Braintrust is a San Francisco-based AI observability platform founded in 2022. The company describes itself as an "active observability platform for agents," built to help development teams trace production activity, run evaluations, and catch regressions before they reach users. Its site emphasizes that AI models can drift and regress silently, and positions Braintrust as a tool for surfacing those patterns automatically so teams can evaluate against expectations and iterate continuously.

The core product, also called Braintrust, is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform. It centers on an evaluation-first approach to large language model development, offering datasets, scorers, CI quality gates, and prompt iteration informed by production trace feedback. The platform also includes a feature called Loop, which the company describes as an AI assistant that generates improved prompts, scorers, and datasets based on what a user wants to optimize. Additionally, Braintrust offers an MCP server that connects a coding agent to a user's AI stack, enabling log queries, eval runs, and prompt updates directly from an IDE.

The site's held facts note 175 law exposure items associated with California, though no specific litigation cases are recorded in the data.
